verdict.rationale: Intel's Core Ultra marketing names an on-chip "Intel Xe Media Engine" for simultaneous play, stream and edit, which suggests hardware media acceleration. That claim sits on the generic Core Ultra family page, not the 285K spec sheet, and names no codecs. Missing for 10: documented AV1/HEVC/ProRes-class encode and decode support, SKU-specific media-engine specs for the 285K, and independent or hands-on corroboration of encode/decode performance.
